paite: Israel kumpipa, David tapa Solomon paunakte.
heading: Paunakte Manphatna
english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

paite: Pilna leh hilhna theihna ding; theihsiamna thute theihkakna ding;
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

paite: thilhih pilhuai a hilhna mu ding, diktatna, vaihawm leh hawmsiamna ah;
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

paite: mimawlte kiang a kivensiamna pe ding, tangval kiang a theihna leh ngentelna.
english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

paite: Mipil in azak theih a, sinsiamna a apuntheihna ding in; theisiammi in thuphate aphaktheihna ding;
english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

paite: Paunak leh lim a thugen theisiam ding; mipilte thute, gentehna thugen theihhakte theisiam ding in.
english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

paite: TOUPA kihtak theihna kipatna ahi; himahleh mihai in pilna leh hilhna amusit.
heading: Tuailaite Thuhilhna
english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

paite: Ka tapa, na pa hilhna za in, na nu dan mangngilh ke'n;
english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

paite: na lu a ding in deihhuai lutang zem leh na ngawng vial ding khainiangte hi ding ahi ngal a.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

paite: Ka tapa, mikhialte'n ahon zol ualeh, pha sakpih ke'n.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

paite: Hon zui in, sisan i buk ding ua, aziak bei in mihoihte aguk in i tang ding uh, achih uleh;
english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

paite: Sheol bang in amaute ahing in i nawmvalh ding ua, huan, kokhuk sung a paisukte bang in,
english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

paite: apum in van manpha tengteng i mu ding ua, gallakte in i innte uh i dimsak ding uh;
english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

paite: na tan kou lak ah na seplut ding a; sumbawm khat i neikhawm ding ua;
english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

paite: ka tapa, lampi ah amau toh ton ke'n; alampi ua kipan na khe kaikik in;
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

paite: gilou hih ding in akhe uh atai ngal a, huan sisan suah ding in akinoh uhi.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

paite: Vasa himhim mitmuh in, len akiphah thawn ngal a,
english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

paite: huan hiaite'n amau sisan ngei atang ua, amau hinna ngei aguk in abuk uhi.
english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

paite: Huchibang tuh michih punna a duhgawlte lampi ahi a; huai in aneitute hinna alakmangsak sek hi.
english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

paite: Kongzing ah ngaihtak in pilna akikou a; mun liante ah a-aw asuah a;
heading: Pilna Akikou
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

paite: mipi omkhawmte munpipen ah akikou a; kongpite lutna ah, khopi ah, athute agen.
english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

paite: Bang tan ahia, nou mimawlte'n, mawlna na it ding uh? Nuihsan mite'n nuihsan a amaute akipah ding ua, mihaite'n theihna ahuat ding uh?
english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

paite: Ka salhna ah kihei unla; ngai in na tung uah ka kha ka sungbo ding, na kiang uah ka thute ka theisak ding hi.
english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

paite: Ka sap a, na nial ziak un; ka bante ka zak a, kuamah in alimsak kei uh.
english: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

paite: Himahleh ka thupha tengteng bangmah lou in na koih ua, ka salhnate bangmah na deih kei uhi.
english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

paite: Ke'n leng na tuahsiat ni un ka hon nuihsan dia; na launa uh ahong tun chiang in ka hon chiamnuih ding;
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

paite: huihpi bang a na launa uh ahong tun chiang in; pingpei bang a na tuahsiatna uh ahong tun chiang in; lungkhamna leh dahna na tung ua ahong tun chiang in.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

paite: Huai hun chiang in kei ahon sam ding ua, himahleh ka dawng kei ding; thanuamtak in ahon zong ding ua, himahleh ahon mu kei ding uh.
english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

paite: Theihna ahuat ua, TOUPA kihtakna azon louh ziak un,
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

paite: ka thupha lak ah bangmah adeih kei ua; ka salhna tengteng amusit uhi.
english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

paite: Huaiziak in alampi uh gah ane ding ua, amau thusawmte ngei in avah ding uhi.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

paite: Mimawlte nungtolhna in amaute athat dia, mihaite hauhsakna in amaute hihmang ding ahih ziak in.
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh kei hon ngaikhia bittak in ateng ding ua, gilou launa pang lou in amuang ding uhi.
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
